current_answer: Choose by unresolved work, not by the number of frontend skills. If a new surface lacks an approved visual target, Frontend App Builder is a conditional concept-and-render path. If a known route needs a bug fix or targeted validation, define the expected state and consider Frontend Testing & Debugging instead. Write project-specific release checks for responsive, interaction, and failure states before treating any skill output as ready. For a sound live site needing only type or color correction, start with screenshots and a small token change. No listed skill has a pool-run comparison against a careful no-skill brief.

catalogue_card.question: Need a new design, or proof the current one works?
catalogue_card.text: If a visual target is missing, Frontend App Builder is a conditional concept-first path. If the screen exists and a change needs checking, define the expected state and use a targeted QA loop. Neither skill sets your release criteria or has a pool-run result comparison.

summary: Choose concept work only when a new visual target is the unresolved decision.
